name: Kidou Shoujo Pretty Gear
original_name: 機動少女プリティギア
source:
Main character is a manga artist waiting for his debut. One day he accidentally obtains a mysterious "Realize Note" with tremendous powers. As a justice warrior "Mobile Suit Gun***" enthusiast, he transforms three girls into justice warrior units. An evil genius plots schemes to acquire these suits. Can hero prevail the the battle, find his true love and finally debut?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名等待出道的漫画家。一天，他意外获得了一本拥有强大力量的神秘“Realize Note”。身为正义战士“机动战士Gun***”的爱好者，他把三名女孩变身为正义战士部队。一名邪恶天才则策划着夺取这些装甲。主人公能否赢得战斗、找到真爱，并最终成功出道？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
